title: Agentic AI for Intent Management and Control in Autonomous Communication Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.31223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven automation will help future mobile networks translate high-level network intents into concrete network optimization or control actions. However, existing approaches often focus on intent management and orchestration, leaving the adaptation of underlying network optimization and control functions largely unaddressed. This article proposes a triadic agentic AI framework that co-designs intent management and intent fulfillment through three agents: an interpreter, powered by a language model, that translates and refines intents into machine-readable optimization templates; an optimizer that adapts controller policies to intent specifications; and a controller that performs fast decision-making. We discuss the design space of each agent and how the workflow can be embedded across network architectural domains. translated_title: 面向自主通信网络意图管理与控制的智能体AI
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）驱动的自动化将帮助未来的移动网络把高层网络意图转化为具体的网络优化或控制动作。然而，现有方法往往只聚焦于意图管理与编排，而底层网络优化和控制功能的适配问题在很大程度上尚未得到解决。本文提出了一种三元智能体AI框架，通过三个智能体协同设计意图管理与意图履行：由语言模型驱动的解释器，负责将意图翻译并细化为机器可读的优化模板；优化器，根据意图规范调整控制器策略；以及控制器，负责执行快速决策。我们讨论了每个智能体的设计空间，以及该工作流如何嵌入到不同的网络架构域中。最后，我们开发了一个具体实现，将语言模型解释器与贝叶斯优化相结合……
tldr: 本文提出了一种由语言模型驱动的解释器、优化器和控制器三个智能体组成的三元智能体AI框架，协同设计意图管理与意图履行，将高层网络意图转化为具体的优化与控制动作，填补了现有研究中底层网络优化控制功能适配的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a triadic agentic AI framework—comprising a language-model-powered interpreter, an optimizer, and a fast-acting controller—that co-designs intent management and intent fulfillment to translate high-level network intents into concrete optimization and control actions in autonomous communication networks.
